deathCause.summary: Died in Medina after a short illness
deathCause.summaryCn: 在麦地那短暂患病后去世
deathCause.detail: Later accounts describe a short final illness; no specific modern diagnosis is secure.
deathCause.detailCn: 后世记载其临终前有短暂病程；无法确定具体病因。

events.label: Became an early supporter of Muhammad
events.labelCn: 成为穆罕默德最早的支持者之一
events.note: Muslim tradition places him among the earliest adult male converts.

events.label: Accompanied Muhammad on the Hijra to Medina
events.labelCn: 陪同穆罕默德完成迁徙至麦地那
events.note: He travelled with Muhammad from Mecca to Medina during the Hijra.

events.label: Was chosen as the first caliph
events.note: Following Muhammad’s death, leading members of the community recognized Abū Bakr as caliph.

events.label: Began the Ridda Wars to restore central authority
events.labelCn: 发动里达战争以恢复共同体的中央权威
events.note: The campaigns answered secessions and rival prophetic claims across Arabia.

events.label: Ordered the first collection of Qurʾanic material
events.labelCn: 下令首次汇集《古兰经》材料
events.note: Tradition associates the first collection with losses among reciters in the Yamama campaign.

events.label: Sent armies into Iraq and Syria
events.labelCn: 派遣军队进入伊拉克与叙利亚
events.note: These expeditions opened the early conquests beyond Arabia.

events.label: Died in Medina
events.note: He nominated ʿUmar as his successor before his death.

sourceNote: Hugh N. Kennedy, The Prophet and the Age of the Caliphates; Fred M. Donner, Muhammad and the Believers; Wikipedia used as a chronology index.
notes:
First caliph of the Rashidun period. The early succession is represented as a political inheritance of the Medinan community, not as a hereditary relationship.

Confidence / caveats: the conventional birth year is approximate; individual early-conversion narratives are rooted in later Islamic tradition.
